title: loadng.rs: Missing hop_limit validation enables RREQ amplification attack
description: process_rreq() at line 623 forwards any RREQ with hop_limit > 0 without validating that hop_limit <= MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15). An attacker can send an RREQ with hop_limit=255, causing it to be forwarded up to 255 times across the network instead of the protocol-intended maximum of 15 hops. This enables flooding/amplification attacks. Additionally, the hop_count calculation at lines 580-581 produces incorrect values (0 hops) for out-of-range hop_limit, allowing attackers to manipulate route metrics to make malicious routes appear more attractive.
